description.value:
You're fascinated with strange phenomena, occult rituals, dangerous magic, and planar beings. You've dedicated your life to unraveling these mysteries and studying the foul magic and dangerous creatures that are often related to them. Recently, you've spotted strange symbols written in blood around Absalom Station, which you believe might have a connection to fiends.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Fiend Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Schooled in Secrets] skill feat.

publication.title: Beyond the Blood Door Player's Guide
